listing.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Hackathon | Superteam Georgia Track
listing.description:
About Superteam Georgia

Superteam Georgia is all about helping people in Georgia find opportunities in the Solana ecosystem. We're here to connect talent with the right projects and help them grow. We believe in empowering developers, designers, and founders to build and ship on Solana. We also host hackathons, like the Crypto World's Fair, to help folks team up, build in public, and compete for prizes.

Mission

Build a project that significantly contributes to the Solana ecosystem, with strong potential for user growth and product-market fit.

Hackathon Track Scope

This track is for projects built by teams in Georgia for the Crypto World's Fair hackathon. We're looking for projects that truly push the boundaries of what's possible on Solana, rather than just being forks of existing ideas. Think about real-world problems that Solana can solve and how your product can bring new users into the ecosystem or deepen engagement for existing ones.

Submission Requirements

  • The Project must be submitted to the Colosseum portal as well as on Superteam Earn.

  • Your project must be eligible as per the official rules of the global hackathon.

  • You must register for the hackathon on the Colosseum platform and mark "Georgia" as your country.

  • You must attend the Offline Demo day.

Judging Criteria

  • Ecosystem Impact: Does this project meaningfully enhance the Solana ecosystem with real infrastructure, tooling, or value?

  • Product-Market Fit on Solana: Is there genuine demand for this on Solana? Does it solve a problem for Solana users, and does it show early signs of traction or validation?

  • User Growth Potential: Will this product bring new users into the Solana ecosystem or deepen engagement for those already in crypto?

Reward Structure

  • 1st Place: 4,000 USDG

  • 2nd Place: 2,500 USDG

  • 3rd Place: 1,500 USDG

  • Bonus Awards: 2 winners receive 1,000 USDG each
